title: The Goonies: Never Say Die
description: An attic map, a pirate legend, and a monster that never made the movie—five Goonies deep cuts.

questions.question: In the Walsh family attic, crammed with their dad's museum pieces, what does Mikey find that starts the hunt?
choices: A pirate's diary in a trunk
A skeleton key in the basement
A message in a bottle on the beach
questions.hint: It was hidden in his father's belongings
questions.explanation: Steven Spielberg dreamed up the story and Chris Columbus wrote it. The stakes: developers are about to foreclose on the Goon Docks and build a country-club golf course.

questions.question: That treasure map leads the Goonies to the booty of what legendary pirate?
questions.hint: He's missing an important facial feature
questions.explanation: Donner kept Willy's 105-foot ship, the Inferno, hidden from the kids until the reveal. Martha Plimpton says her gasp was real; Sean Astin admits he peeked.

questions.question: Before the hunt for One-Eyed Willy's treasure, Chunk must perform what belly-jiggling dance to get through the Walshes' gate?
questions.hint: Come on, do the truffle shuffle!
questions.explanation: Mouth demands it. Jeff Cohen later admitted he was recovering from chickenpox, so makeup covered the spots on his belly. He grew up to be an entertainment lawyer.

questions.question: Chunk, of Truffle Shuffle fame, ends up best friends with which Fratelli brother, kept chained in the family's basement?
questions.explanation: Chunk wins him over with a Baby Ruth ("Ruth! Ruth! Baby Ruth!"). Sloth was ex-Raiders lineman John Matuszak; his prosthetic head, radio-controlled eye included, took about five hours to apply.

questions.question: Back on the beach after Sloth's big rescue, Data tells reporters something "was really scary," a creature cut from the movie. What was it?
questions.explanation: "I ad-libbed the line," Ke Huy Quan said. "But in the film there was no octopus and they kept that line." The cut scene resurfaced on TV airings and the 2001 DVD.
questions.hint: Eight arms, zero minutes of screen time

easterEgg.title: Eight Arms to Hold You
easterEgg.text: In the cut scene, Data scares off the octopus by jamming his Walkman in its mouth, blasting "Eight Arms to Hold You" by the Goon Squad. The title borrows the working title of the Beatles' Help!
